parametrized_description: A fashion brand sells NumberOfArticles articles of clothing. Each article has an initial price InitialPrices and a price elasticity Elasticities. Price changes must be in multiples of 1 euro. At most a fraction MaxPriceChange of prices can be changed. Each new price must be within MaxPriceDeviation of the initial price. Each article has a maximum production volume MaxProductionVolume. Given sales forecasts SalesForecast per article, choose new integer prices for each article to maximize total expected revenue.

NumberOfArticles.description: Number of articles in the assortment

MaxPriceChange.description: Maximum fraction of prices that can be changed

MaxPriceDeviation.description: Maximum allowed deviation of each new price from the initial price as a fraction

MaxProductionVolume.description: Maximum production volume for each article

NewPrice.description: New price for each article in euros

Changed.description: Binary indicator of whether the price of each article is changed

constraints.description: The new price for each article must be at least (1 - MaxPriceDeviation) times the initial price.

code.gurobipy:
import math
model.addConstrs((NewPrice[i] >= math.ceil(InitialPrices[i] * (1 - MaxPriceDeviation)) for i in range(NumberOfArticles)), name="PriceLB")

constraints.description: The new price for each article must be at most (1 + MaxPriceDeviation) times the initial price.

code.gurobipy:
import math
model.addConstrs((NewPrice[i] <= math.floor(InitialPrices[i] * (1 + MaxPriceDeviation)) for i in range(NumberOfArticles)), name="PriceUB")

constraints.description: If a price is changed, the Changed indicator must be 1.
constraints.formulation: NewPrice_i - InitialPrices_i \leq M_i \times Changed_i \quad \forall i \\ InitialPrices_i - NewPrice_i \leq M_i \times Changed_i \quad \forall i

code.gurobipy:
for i in range(NumberOfArticles):
    M_i = math.floor(InitialPrices[i] * MaxPriceDeviation)
    model.addConstr(NewPrice[i] - InitialPrices[i] <= M_i * Changed[i], name=f"ChangedUB_{i}")
    model.addConstr(InitialPrices[i] - NewPrice[i] <= M_i * Changed[i], name=f"ChangedLB_{i}")

constraints.description: At most MaxPriceChange fraction of all articles can have their price changed.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(quicksum(Changed[i] for i in range(NumberOfArticles)) <= MaxPriceChange * NumberOfArticles, name="MaxChanges")

constraints.description: Expected sales for each article cannot exceed the maximum production volume.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((SalesForecast[i] * (NewPrice[i] / InitialPrices[i]) ** Elasticities[i] <= MaxProductionVolume[i] for i in range(NumberOfArticles)), name="MaxProd")

objective.description: Maximize total expected revenue across all articles, where expected sales depend on price elasticity.

code.gurobipy: model.setObjective(quicksum(NewPrice[i] * SalesForecast[i] * (NewPrice[i] / InitialPrices[i]) ** Elasticities[i] for i in range(NumberOfArticles)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)
